title: Russell E. Train Fellowships for Conservation Leaders
institution: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), Russell E. Train Education for Nature Program

compensation.value: Up to US$15,000 per year, for up to two years
compensation.evidence_quote: Fellows can apply for up to two years of funding, at up to $15,000 per year.

about: WWF fellowships supporting master's and doctoral study in conservation for citizens of listed countries in Africa, Asia, the Pacific and Latin America, with up to two years of funding. Applications close 15 December 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern; decisions expected February 2027.
requirements: Pursuing a master's or doctoral degree in conservation or a related field
Nationals of the eligible countries listed on the official page (in Africa, Asia, the Pacific and Latin America)
